name: Upright weaving loom
description: A warp-weighted loom about 1.8 m high: two timber uprights on braced foot beams carrying a cloth beam with a half-woven, blue- and red-banded woollen cloth hanging from it, and below it the warp threads in two layers, the back one over a shed rod, each bundle tied to a hanging clay weight.

provenance.prompt: An upright weaving loom with a half-woven cloth and weights, about 1.4 × 0.6 × 1.8 m.
